subject: Link macOS modules with the compiler driver (#4927)
reason: The change is purely a build-system fix: three Makefiles (src/modules, src/modules/lua, tests/modules) switch the macOS-only link step for modules from raw ld with a hardcoded SDK libSystem path to linking via the compiler driver ($(CC) $(CFLAGS)). It is guarded by uname_S == Darwin, so Linux builds — where the fuzzer runs — are byte-for-byte unaffected, and even on macOS it changes only how module shared objects are linked, not any runtime behaviour, command reply, replication, persistence or module API path. There is no server behaviour to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
